subject: Next-phase MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@novahealth.com, elena.perez@novahealth.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + sequencing ask — MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Hi Elena / NovaHealth procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. To keep momentum I’m attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that calls out the key legal and procurement dependencies we typically see for a close:

- MSA redline turnaround (legal)
- DPA / data flow review (privacy team)
- Order form pricing approval (procurement / finance)
- Security evidence (SOC 2 + attestation)

Can you confirm the following so we can map owner lanes and an honest timeline?
1) Who will be the primary legal reviewer and their expected redline window?
2) Procurement approver and any pre-approval steps (PO process, budget window)?
3) Any additional required security artifacts beyond SOC 2 (e.g., penetration test report)?

We’ve penciled a 2-week legal cycle in the MAP if the DPA has standard redlines; if NovaHealth needs an internal vendor review board sign-off that will add time. Please review the attached MAP (NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) and I can update the lanes.

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx, OrderForm_Draft_20270104.docx

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai

From: Elena Perez <elena.perez@novahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: Kevin Shah <kevin.shah@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + sequencing ask — MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the MAP — useful summary. Quick answers from legal/procurement side:

- Legal reviewer: Elena Perez (me) + privacy SME. Typical turnaround: 7–10 business days for initial redline if the DPA is standard. If there are custom sub-processor requests, add another 5 business days.
- Procurement approver: Kevin Shah (cc’d). We need a completed order form + vendor questionnaire before we route to finance for PO issuance; budget window is end of month (Jan 31) for this quarter.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 (Type II) is required; we also ask for a recent penetration test summary (high-level findings). Full reports can be via secure share if needed.

I’ve attached a short annotated DPA with the clauses we typically redline for vendor-side language (see DPA_redline_comments.pdf). Please call out any sub-processors in the MAP and confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA supports data residency requirements — if NovaHealth needs EU-only processing we’ll need to review exports.

If we want to close in this quarter (target Jan 28–31), legal + procurement need the final order form by Jan 18 at the latest. Otherwise the approval will slip to the next PO cycle.

Thanks,
Elena Perez
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
NovaHealth
elena.perez@novahealth.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Elena Perez <elena.perez@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + sequencing ask — MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Team —

Elena’s note is clear: if NovaHealth wants to hit the Jan 28–31 PO window we need to deliver the finalized order form and DPA by Jan 18. Two immediate asks for our side:

1) Irene — can you produce the SOC 2 attestation + a short penetration test summary we can upload to their secure portal?
2) Jonas — legal will want a pre-filled order form with the pricing line items and billing contact. Can you confirm the final seat/usage numbers so I can drop them in?

I’ll update the MAP with lanes by owner and a proposed per-day cadence. I’ve attached an action-tracker.csv to capture owners & dates. If we can agree to an internal deadline of Jan 12 for our artifacts, we’ll have a 6-day buffer to incorporate NovaHealth redlines before their Jan 18 cutoff.

Attachments: action-tracker.csv

Sergio

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Perez <elena.perez@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + sequencing ask — MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Sergio / team —

On Mon, Jan 4, 2027 at 11:08 AM Elena Perez <elena.perez@novahealth.com> wrote:
> I’ve attached a short annotated DPA with the clauses we typically redline for vendor-side language (see DPA_redline_comments.pdf).

Thanks Elena — that’s helpful. We have a current SOC 2 Type II report (rolling 12 months) and can produce a one-page attestation summary tailored to NovaHealth. I’ll also extract an anonymized penetration test executive summary (no raw exploit data) and upload both to a secure share by EOD Jan 6.

Related point: does NovaHealth require a specific sub-processor list format? If so we should include that in the MAP (left column: sub-processor name / purpose / location).

I’ve started pre-filling the order form with baseline pricing and two optional add-ons (premium support + dedicated throughput pool). Jonas — please validate the usage tiers so I can lock numbers.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Perez <elena.perez@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Scheduling: legal sync + onboarding milestone alignment

Sergio / Irene / Vanessa / Elena —

I’m proposing a 30-minute legal sync to walk through the redline priorities and confirm the onboarding start date (so NovaHealth can plan staging access). Suggested slots (CET):
- Tue Jan 12, 09:00–09:30
- Tue Jan 12, 16:00–16:30

Agenda: 1) DPA redline walk, 2) order form items & billing contact, 3) security evidence delivery timeline, 4) onboarding start date and staging playbook handoff.

If Kevin / procurement prefers a different cadence we can adapt — the goal is to lock the order form for legal review by Jan 18. I’ll include CS for onboarding once we confirm the start date.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Elena Perez <elena.perez@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com, Kevin Shah <kevin.shah@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP update + hubspot/linked artifacts — please confirm owners by EOD Jan 12

Team / NovaHealth —

Thanks for the quick turn. I’ve consolidated the lanes and updated the MAP to reflect the Jan 18 legal cutoff and the PO window Jan 28–31. Action items (owners & deadlines):

- Redwood: SOC2 attestation + pen-test summary — Irene — due 2027-01-06 (DELIVERED to secure share)
- Redwood: Pre-filled order form with final pricing — Jonas — due 2027-01-10 (in progress)
- Redwood: Action tracker (owners/dates) — Sergio — updated 2027-01-11
- NovaHealth: Initial DPA comments — Elena — requested by 2027-01-14
- NovaHealth: Procurement final sign-off / PO submission — Kevin / procurement team — target 2027-01-28 to 2027-01-31

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx, DPA_redline_comments.pdf, OrderForm_Draft_20270104.docx, action-tracker.csv
